The '''Diplomat Hotel''' was a large hotel skyscraper complex on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], located in the [[Plains of Coruscant]]. It served various representatives of other worlds and would offer each of its visitors a simulated [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that would suit their preferences.
